gloss_en: Yichuda Tata'ah — the kabbalistic "Lower Unification" (Aramaic: יחודא תתאה), the lower mode of divine union associated in Likutey Moharan 11 with weekday union (zivug shel chol), God's governance during the six weekdays, Metatron, Halakhah, and "razin" — paired with and contrasted to Yichuda Ila'ah (the Supernal Unification)
